rhythm.sent_len_mean.label: mean sentence length (words)
rhythm.sent_len_mean.fix: Too long: split sentences that chain clauses with commas; one main idea per sentence, two at most. Too short: join clipped sentences that belong to one thought.

rhythm.long_share.label: share of long sentences (>=30 words)
rhythm.long_share.fix: Split sentences that carry three or more ideas at their logical joints (because, but, which).

rhythm.short_share.label: share of short sentences (<=10 words)
rhythm.short_share.fix: Give a key finding or a turn in the argument its own short sentence, but do not chop every thought into fragments.

punctuation.comma_per_sentence.label: commas per sentence
punctuation.comma_per_sentence.fix: Break comma-chained enumerations and clause strings; one idea per clause.

rhythm.sent_len_cv.label: sentence-length variation (CV)
rhythm.sent_len_cv.fix: Vary sentence length with the content: a short plain sentence where a point lands, a long qualified one where reasoning needs room. Break the uniform run shown under 'Where to look'.

rhythm.masd_norm.label: sentence-to-sentence length change
rhythm.masd_norm.fix: Alternate lengths where the content allows.

rhythm.uniform_run_max.label: longest run of similar-length sentences
rhythm.uniform_run_max.fix: Break the run: merge two of its sentences or isolate one point.

paragraphs.para_words_cv.label: paragraph-length variation
paragraphs.para_words_cv.fix: Let paragraph length follow the content: a short paragraph for a pivot or a key result, a longer one for an argument.

lexical.mattr50.label: word variety, all words (MATTR-50 on lemmas)
lexical.mattr50.fix: Variety above the human range rarely comes from synonyms. It comes from compressed phrasing: few articles and 'of', few forms of 'be', a new content word in every slot. Write full clauses, and reuse the established term instead of a variant.

lexical.yule_k.label: repeat rate (Yule's K)
lexical.yule_k.fix: Too low means the common words are spread too thin: let 'the', 'of', 'is' and the key terms recur as they do in ordinary prose.

lexical.content_types_at_50.label: content-word variety (distinct per 50 content words)
lexical.content_types_at_50.fix: Too high: stop rotating near-synonyms and upgraded words; name a thing once and keep the name. Too low: the same few abstract words are recycled; use the precise word for each thing.

lexical.glue_per100.label: glue words per 100 tokens (the, of, be, to, in)
lexical.glue_per100.fix: Unpack compressed phrases into ordinary clauses: 'coastal erosion risk assessment tools' -> 'tools for assessing the risk of erosion on the coast'; 'X remains unclear' -> 'it is not clear whether X'. Use 'is/are/was' with an adjective or noun where that is the plain way to say it.

pos.lexical_density.label: lexical density (content words / all words)
pos.lexical_density.fix: The text packs too many content words per sentence. Spread the load: one claim per clause, with its articles, prepositions and auxiliaries.

lexical.fw_types_at_50.label: function-word variety
lexical.fw_types_at_50.fix: Do not rotate connectors and prepositions for variety (across, within, through, amid, beyond); the plain ones (in, of, on, for) recur in human text.

lexical.word_len_mean.label: mean word length (letters)
lexical.word_len_mean.fix: Prefer the short everyday word where it says the same thing: use (not utilise), show (not demonstrate), need (not necessitate), about (not approximately), help (not facilitate).

markers.ai_function_per1k.label: function words current models over-use, per 1k
markers.ai_function_per1k.fix: Cut or rephrase the listed words (see 'Words current models over-use'): 'how/what/whether' clauses used as abstract objects ('understanding how X shapes Y' -> 'the effect of X on Y'), 'rather than', 'across', 'through', 'despite', 'beyond', 'itself', 'yet'.

markers.ai_content_per1k.label: content words current models over-use, per 1k
markers.ai_content_per1k.fix: Replace the listed words with the plain one a specialist would use, or drop the sentence if it only frames (see 'Words current models over-use').

markers.human_function_per1k.label: everyday function words people use more (also, as, by, there, such ...), per 1k
markers.human_function_per1k.fix: Write the ordinary way: 'there is', 'such as', 'as well', 'also', 'by' after a passive, 'we' where the genre allows. Do not replace them with tighter constructions.

markers.plain_per1k.label: plain workhorse words people use, per 1k
markers.plain_per1k.fix: Use the ordinary verbs and adjectives of the field: use, show, find, include, increase, lead to; high, low, new, similar, good.

pos.specificity_pct.label: names + acronyms + numbers (% of tokens)
pos.specificity_pct.fix: Surface the specific names, abbreviations and numbers already in the source instead of category words ('several cities' -> 'Lyon and Turin'). Never invent.

pos.propn_pct.label: proper nouns (% of tokens)
pos.propn_pct.fix: Use the names the source provides (datasets, methods, places, authors, instruments). Never invent them.

pos.num_pct.label: numbers (% of tokens)
pos.num_pct.fix: State the quantities the source gives (sample sizes, effect sizes, dates) where the text now says 'many', 'large', 'recent'.

punctuation.punct_entropy_nodash.label: punctuation variety (dashes excluded)
punctuation.punct_entropy_nodash.fix: Use parentheses for abbreviations, asides and exact values; a semicolon between tightly related clauses; a colon to introduce. Not dashes.

punctuation.nonbasic_share_nodash.label: share of marks other than , and . (dashes excluded)

punctuation.per1k.parenthesis.label: parentheses per 1k
punctuation.per1k.parenthesis.fix: Put abbreviations, units, exact values and brief asides in parentheses, as papers do.

pos.deriv_adv_pct.label: derived adverbs (-ly / -ment, % of tokens)
pos.deriv_adv_pct.fix: Cut intensifying and decorative adverbs (dramatically, increasingly, fundamentally, particularly); keep those that carry information (rarely, previously, randomly).

pos.adj_pct.label: adjectives (% of tokens)
pos.adj_pct.fix: Cut stacked evaluative adjectives; keep the ones that classify (thermal, randomized, 1-km).

pos.verb_pct.label: lexical verbs (% of tokens)
pos.verb_pct.fix: Too many action verbs doing abstract work (shapes, reflects, requires, enables, remains): say what is the case with 'is/are/has' or name who did what.

pos.aux_pct.label: auxiliaries: be / have / do (% of tokens)
pos.aux_pct.fix: Human prose leans on 'is', 'are', 'was', 'has been'. Let simple statements be simple: 'X is common in Y'.

structure.passive_sentence_share.label: sentences with a passive
structure.passive_sentence_share.fix: People use the passive where the doer is unknown or beside the point ('the samples were stored at 4 °C', 'the bill was passed'). Do not force every sentence active.

nominal.nominal_heavy_share.label: sentences with >=3 nominalisations
nominal.nominal_heavy_share.fix: Rewrite the listed clusters with verbs.

nominal.nominalization_per1k.label: nominalisations per 1k
nominal.nominalization_per1k.fix: Convert -tion/-ment/-ness/-ity nouns back into verbs where an actor exists.

pos.noun_verb_ratio.label: noun-to-verb ratio
pos.noun_verb_ratio.fix: Turn nominalisations back into verbs: 'the optimization of X' -> 'optimizing X'.

pos.nominal_verbal_ratio.label: nominal vs verbal style
pos.nominal_verbal_ratio.fix: More verbs and pronouns, fewer noun stacks.

pos.of_per100.label: 'of' per 100 words
pos.of_per100.fix: Too low is as telling as too high: human prose uses 'of' phrases freely ('the rate of loss', 'most of the samples').

padding.participial_clause_per1k.label: comment clauses after a comma (', highlighting ...') per 1k
padding.participial_clause_per1k.fix: Cut the trailing clause or turn it into its own sentence with a subject and a finite verb that states a fact.

padding.shell_noun_per1k.label: abstract framing nouns per 1k
padding.shell_noun_per1k.fix: Replace the frame with the thing: 'plays a role in the regulation of' -> 'regulates'; 'the challenge of X' -> 'X is hard because ...'.

padding.metadiscourse_per1k.label: announcements about the text per 1k
padding.metadiscourse_per1k.fix: Say the thing instead of announcing it ('It is worth noting that X' -> 'X').

padding.wordy_per1k.label: wordy stock phrases per 1k
padding.wordy_per1k.fix: Shorten where nothing is lost ('in order to' -> 'to'). A few are normal in human prose; a pile is filler.

padding.double_hedge_per1k.label: stacked hedges per 1k
padding.double_hedge_per1k.fix: One hedge per claim: 'may potentially suggest' -> 'suggests' or 'may'.

padding.binomial_per1k.label: doublets ('robust and reliable') per 1k
padding.binomial_per1k.fix: Keep the word that carries the meaning; drop its near-synonym.

padding.restatement_share.label: sentences that mostly repeat an earlier one
padding.restatement_share.fix: Delete the restatement or make it add a fact, a number or a consequence.

padding.expletive_opener_share.label: sentences opening with 'There is / It is ... that'
padding.expletive_opener_share.fix: Start with the subject that does something.

stock.triad_lists_per1k.label: lists of three per 1k
stock.triad_lists_per1k.fix: Keep lists the content needs; cut padded enumerations; one precise example beats three vague ones.

stock.stock_per1k.label: stock phrases per 1k
stock.stock_per1k.fix: Replace each listed stock phrase with the specific claim, or delete it.

stock.significance_echo_per1k.label: significance-echo sentences per 1k
stock.significance_echo_per1k.fix: Delete sentences that only restate importance.

document.paragraph_wrapup_share.label: paragraphs ending on a summary/significance line
document.paragraph_wrapup_share.fix: End paragraphs on the last substantive point.

connectives.connective_initial_share.label: sentences opening with a connective
connectives.connective_initial_share.fix: Delete connectives whose logic is already obvious.

connectives.formulaic_initial_share.label: formulaic openers (Furthermore / Moreover / Overall ...)
connectives.formulaic_initial_share.fix: Delete them; if a relation is needed, state it inside the sentence.

connectives.logical_connective_share.label: logical connectives share (contrast / cause / condition)
connectives.logical_connective_share.fix: Make the reasoning explicit where it exists: but, because, although, unless.

stance.hedges_per1k.label: hedges per 1k
stance.hedges_per1k.fix: Hedge only where evidence is uncertain, tied to the specific claim.

stance.attitude_per1k.label: attitude markers per 1k
stance.attitude_per1k.fix: Say what is surprising, disappointing or unexpected when the source supports it.

stance.self_mention_per1k.label: self-mention per 1k
stance.self_mention_per1k.fix: Let the authors appear where the genre allows ('we measured', 'we suspect').

stance.stance_per1k.label: stance markers per 1k
stance.stance_per1k.fix: Take positions the evidence supports; mark real uncertainty; evaluate.

pos.comparative_per1k.label: comparatives / superlatives per 1k
pos.comparative_per1k.fix: State comparisons the evidence supports, with what is compared to what.

sentiment.critical_per1k.label: critical / negative evaluation per 1k
sentiment.critical_per1k.fix: Keep problems and limitations at the strength the source states them.

sentiment.promo_per1k.label: promotional vocabulary per 1k
sentiment.promo_per1k.fix: Cut promotional adjectives (crucial, robust, comprehensive, transformative, invaluable ...).

structure.subject_initial_share.label: subject-first sentences
structure.subject_initial_share.fix: Open some sentences with the condition, contrast, time or cause that frames them ('Because ...', 'In 2018 ...', 'Unlike X ...').

structure.skeleton_entropy.label: sentence-skeleton variety
structure.skeleton_entropy.fix: Vary sentence architecture, not just words.

function_words.ai_fw_per1k.label: function words reported as AI-favoured (and / can / by / with / for / their) per 1k
function_words.ai_fw_per1k.fix: Fewer additive 'and' chains and 'can + verb' generalities; say who does what.

function_words.human_fw_per1k.label: function words reported as human-favoured per 1k
function_words.human_fw_per1k.fix: Reason out loud: but, because, although, if, when, would, might.

pos.cconj_pct.label: coordinating conjunctions (% of tokens)
pos.cconj_pct.fix: Fewer 'X and Y and Z' chains; subordinate instead (because, although, when).

pos.pron_pct.label: pronouns (% of tokens)
pos.pron_pct.fix: Refer back with it / this / they / we where the referent is clear instead of repeating full noun phrases.

lexical.repeated_3gram_per1k.label: repeated 3-grams per 1k
lexical.repeated_3gram_per1k.fix: Rephrase recycled phrases (protect real technical terms with --protect).

lexical.repeated_frame_share.label: repeated sentence frames
lexical.repeated_frame_share.fix: Vary openers: 'This approach ...', 'These findings ...' repeated is a template.
